opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships

next_open_date.raw: The award should commence within 15 months of receipt of the offer letter.

amount.raw: Applicants may apply for a minimum of £10,000 and a maximum of £150,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas, to bring genuinely novel expertise and enhance the skills and knowledge of academic staff and students in an underrepresented area of research, within the UK.
opportunities.summary: For UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas, to bring genuinely novel expertise and enhance the skills and knowledge of academic staff and students in an underrepresented area of research, within the UK. Priority will be given to new or recent collaborations and visits with a variety of activities beyond research.
